title: Grateful Dead Live at Meadowlands Arena on 1988-04-01
source:
*Set 1 Only*
Soundboard (Healy Ultra Box)->DAT Master->DAT. DAT->ZA2->Soundforge(recording)->.wav->mkw->SHN. Transfer and SHN by Joe Samaritano. De-popping by Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard mix captures a solid show highlighted by the rare “Thin Man,” a stellar “To Lay Me Down,” and a killer “Deal.”
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the recording, calling it the best‑sounding mix they’ve heard for this date. The performance is described as solid with a ripping first set featuring the seldom‑played Thin Man and a standout Deal, leading into an energetic second set. Overall the show is praised as enjoyable and well captured.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are positive (4‑5 stars) and highlight a strong musical performance plus an outstanding soundboard mix; with only two detailed reviews confidence is medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix praised as the best heard for this date, clear and well‑balanced soundboard recording with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as ripping and energetic; second set noted as great, giving the concert a strong overall flow.
